caveats: This is within-library partial-observation prediction, not unseen-library transfer.
Space-filling is deterministic and therefore has one repeat.
Random strategy means and standard deviations are over repeated random observed-position sets.
The result is a measurement-budget design probe for Track B, not a materials discovery benchmark.
normalization: log1p(nonnegative intensity), then per-spectrum max normalization.
pre_run_hypothesis: If each HTEM sample library behaves like a spatial measurement field, prediction of unmeasured positions should improve as the number of observed positions increases. Space-filling sampling should beat random sampling at small budgets if spatial coverage matters.
